name: PaletteBonePlain
intent: The dead giant's bleached bone plain under a cold moon: grey-white bone-dust ground, dark trodden road, neutral wind-cut grey rock and a paler far land, with a dry dusk-rose on the grave cloth as the one accent.
requests: A bleached-bone terrain material or Sand MaterialVariant: the plain is fine chalky bone dust, but Sand's grain reads as dune sand up close.
A rib-bone prop role (great curved ribs and a vertebra line) so the pale rock and dusk-rose grave cloth have a giant to hang on as the area's landmark.

critic_pass1.why: The inverted value plan (pale ground, dark trodden road) is unmistakable and reads clearly, but the plain is khaki-olive rather than bleached bone and edges toward washed out, and the dusk-rose is a bit soft.
critic_pass1.fix: walk sand desaturated and cooled toward grey-white bone (less olive) while keeping its value, so it reads as bone dust not dry grass

critic_pass2.why: The ground moved from sand-yellow toward grey bone, which helps the bleached-plain idea, and the inverted dark road on a pale floor is unlike any other candidate, but the pale ground lifts the whole frame toward washed-out, and the far limestone sits close to the walkable.
